card.name: Strong edge colourings of three fixed bounded-degree graphs
card.family: science prize i strong edge colouring

task.name: Strong edge colourings of three fixed bounded-degree graphs
task.family: science prize i strong edge colouring
task.description: construct() -> three lists of edge colours, one per instance from bounded_degree_graph(n, d, seed) for (40,4,101), (60,5,102), (80,6,103) in the verifier; colours follow the sorted edge order. Each colour class must be an induced matching (no two edges share a vertex or are joined by an edge). Minimize the total number of colours used; the Erdős-Nešetřil conjecture predicts at most 5d^2/4 per instance (20 + 31 + 45). The score totals colours on three fixed graphs of maximum degree 4, 5 and 6; it measures a colouring method, not the conjecture.
